name: Android ARM64 (AOSP/Google APIs, emulator ranchu TCG)
version: 9 (API 28) - verified 2304 MiB normal-mode TCG second boot, experimental
risk: Experimental only. Upstream toolkit patches Android/emulator binaries, disables some HALs and SELinux enforcement; do not use with sensitive user accounts or secrets.
description: Real normal-mode Android 9 ARM64 TCG second boots passed at 4096 MiB (run 41251519179) and 2304 MiB (run 41252841437), each with five same-PID system_server checks and Launcher3 evidence, clean QCOW2 and immutable base. Prior ART/ShortcutParser crash was intermittent. ChatGPT 4GiB cgroup host run and repeatability still unproven; status intentionally experimental.
